purpose: Questions that must be answered before a sell-vs-renew decision can be made reasonably, what is already known from verified official sources, what is missing, and exactly how to obtain the missing information. Missing-information discovery is a deliverable, not an excuse for guessing.

questions.question: What is the exact lease expiration date and are there renewal options (count, length, notice deadline)?
questions.known_answer: Only the 2030-2035 window is known (brief). Exact date unknown.
questions.obtain: Executed lease + amendments; confirm with tenant in writing. Store internal only — never publish.

questions.question: What is the current annual base rent, escalation schedule, and NNN reimbursement structure?
questions.known_answer: Unknown; owner-private.
questions.obtain: Lease and rent roll; estoppel certificate from tenant.

questions.question: Is the tenant a franchisee or company-owned, and what is the franchisee's credit/guarantor?
questions.known_answer: System-wide ~93% franchised (S05, computed M35). Site-specific status unknown.
questions.obtain: Lease guarantor documents; tenant estoppel; check SOS records (CA SOS business search).

questions.question: Is the property inside the City of Los Angeles (Measure ULA exposure) or elsewhere in LA County?
questions.known_answer: Unknown. If City of LA: sale > $5.4M pays 4% on FULL price; ≥ $10.9M pays 5.5% (S10).
questions.obtain: Deed/title report; LA County Assessor parcel lookup (address private); confirm zoning city/county.

questions.question: What is the property's assessed value and how much Prop 13 headroom is there?
questions.known_answer: Prop 13 caps assessed-value growth at 2%/yr; base 1% + bonded indebtedness (S16). Site-specific assessed value unknown.
questions.obtain: LA County Assessor annual notice / tax bill.

questions.question: What cap rate should price the asset today?
questions.known_answer: No official source publishes cap rates; broker surveys are not official → blank (M28).
questions.obtain: Licensed broker/appraiser opinion of value + at least two QSR NNN comparable sales; flag all non-official inputs.

questions.question: What is the asset's likely sale price range?
questions.known_answer: Cannot be derived without rent (Q02) and cap rate (Q06) → deliberately blank.
questions.obtain: Broker opinion of value; do not accept a single number.

questions.question: What is the owner's adjusted basis and expected capital gain on sale?
questions.known_answer: Unknown; owner-private.
questions.obtain: Tax returns/CPA schedule; depreciation history.

questions.question: Is a 1031 exchange feasible and desirable vs a taxable sale?
questions.known_answer: §1031 limited to real property since 2018; property held for sale does NOT qualify (S11). Feasibility depends on Q08 and owner objectives.
questions.obtain: CPA + qualified intermediary; replacement-property search if owner wants to defer.

questions.question: Is the 10Y Treasury environment favorable for NNN pricing?
questions.known_answer: DGS10 = 4.88% (2026-11-09), elevated vs 2020-21; upward rate pressure compresses NNN valuations (S02).
questions.obtain: FRED DGS10 tracked monthly.

questions.question: Is LA's labor market strengthening or weakening?
questions.known_answer: County SA unemployment 4.8% (Sep 2026, down from 5.6% a year ago); nonfarm +0.4% y/y; MSA 4.4%; CA 5.1% (S01, S09).
questions.obtain: EDD monthly release; BLS LAUS.

questions.question: What is the trajectory of local population and income (the demand base)?
questions.known_answer: City pop -0.8% and county pop -3.2% since Apr 2020; median HH income $81,939 city / $90,112 county; poverty 16.5% / 13.3% (S03).
questions.obtain: Census QuickFacts annual refresh.

questions.question: What is LA County's personal income scale and growth?
questions.known_answer: $818.5B in 2024 — largest county economy in the US (S07). Growth rate this release not quoted in the release text; obtain BEA interactive table.
questions.obtain: BEA interactive GDP-by-county tables (apps.bea.gov).

questions.question: Is the port economy supporting Central LA employment?
questions.known_answer: Port of LA handled 9.45M TEUs Jan-Nov 2025, heading for a top-3 year; Nov imports -11% y/y (S15). Link to site-specific employment needs establishment-level data.
questions.obtain: BEA county industry GDP; EDD industry detail (already summarized in S09 release).

questions.question: Is the tenant (Jack in the Box) credit improving or deteriorating?
questions.known_answer: Q3 FY2026: SSS -1.1%, systemwide sales -1.4%, restaurant count -53 y/y to 2,115, franchise-level margin 37.4% (vs 39.3%); Del Taco sold 2025-12-22; refinancing complete; interim CEO; 'JACK on Track' closures (S05, S06).
questions.obtain: Track FY2026 10-K (expected Dec 2026) and quarterly 8-Ks.

questions.question: Does the NNN lease pass ALL operating costs (incl. structural/roof/parking) to the tenant?
questions.known_answer: Unknown; 'NNN' per brief but coverage scope unverified.
questions.obtain: Lease clauses on roof/structure/parking/ADA; estoppel.

questions.question: What is the seismic and wildfire exposure of the specific parcel?
questions.known_answer: LA region: 60% 30-yr M6.7+, 46% M7.0+, 31% M7.5+ (S12). Parcel-specific fire hazard class unknown and blank (M55).
questions.obtain: CAL FIRE FHSZ viewer lookup by address (private); USGS NSHM; insurer inspection.

questions.question: Can the owner get/keep property insurance at reasonable cost?
questions.known_answer: Unknown; CA insurance market stress is public knowledge but premium data is not official.
questions.obtain: Broker quotes (2+ carriers + FAIR Plan fallback); lender requirements if any.

questions.question: What is the quality and trajectory of schools serving the site?
questions.known_answer: Blank (M61, M62). No official rating system re-verified this session.
questions.obtain: California Department of Education DataQuest + LAUSD official reports; GreatSchools only as clearly-labeled third party.

questions.question: Are there title defects, easements, ADA/CEQA issues, or condemnation risk (e.g., public works)?
questions.known_answer: Unknown.
questions.obtain: Preliminary title report; municipal permit/public-works search.

questions.question: What does the owner want: income now, growth, liquidity, or estate/legacy?
questions.known_answer: Owner's wealth objective stated only as 'preservation of wealth and opportunity for growth'. Preferences weighting unknown.
questions.obtain: Written owner objectives + constraints (liquidity needs, time horizon, tax bracket, concentration limits).

questions.question: What is the owner's concentration risk (how much of net worth is this one asset)?
questions.known_answer: Unknown.
questions.obtain: Owner financial statement (internal only).

questions.question: Would a sale-leaseback or 1031 into a diversified replacement asset beat a renewal hold?
questions.known_answer: Structurally possible; depends on Q02, Q06-Q09 and owner objectives (S11).
questions.obtain: Model both scenarios (see projection-model.html) with owner's actual numbers.

questions.question: What is the earliest realistic decision deadline?
questions.known_answer: Unknown; lease window 2030-2035 implies a decision needed 12-36 months before expiry to market the asset or negotiate renewal.
questions.obtain: Work backward from the exact expiration date (Q01) + renewal notice deadline.
